keywords.Front: Slot 1, the unit that gets attacked.
keywords.Ahead / Behind: The ally one slot nearer the Front / the Back.
keywords.Adjacent: The allies directly Ahead and Behind.
keywords.Start of fight: Fires once before the first attack (see Foresight).
keywords.On attack: Fires after this unit's attack lands.
keywords.On hurt: Fires when this unit takes damage and survives.
keywords.Guard N: Takes N less damage from each hit (never below 1). Guards add up.
keywords.Endure: The first time it would die, it stays at 1 health instead.
keywords.Snipe: Its attacks hit the enemy Back unit instead of the Front.
keywords.Back-hit: An attack that also deals damage to the enemy Back unit.
keywords.Cleave: Its attack also hits the enemy behind the target.
keywords.Pierce: Its attacks ignore Guard, and break Ward without being blocked.
keywords.Shelter: Enemy hits aimed at allies behind the Front land on this unit instead.
keywords.Smother: Enemy summons and Stitches arrive at 1 health with no ability.
keywords.Blight: Enemies can't heal, gain health, Endure or be Stitched.
keywords.Silence: Loses its abilities, passives and House bonuses for this fight.
keywords.Filed: The enemy's first triggered ability this fight fizzles.
keywords.Foresight: Your start-of-fight abilities all resolve before the enemy's.
keywords.Leap: Strikes the enemy Front at start of fight (not an attack).
keywords.Riposte: Hits back at whoever hurt it.
keywords.Summon: Adds a unit to the line, if a slot is free (max 5).
keywords.Stitch: Brings a fallen ally back with 1 health.
keywords.Devour: Destroys or eats a unit to take its stats.
keywords.Relay: Makes another unit repeat its start-of-fight ability.
keywords.Echo: Makes an on-death ability fire again.
keywords.Giant-slayer: Deals double damage to bigger targets.
keywords.Brace: The side that attacks second starts with +1 health on its Front unit.
keywords.Glue: A neutral that counts toward two Houses' synergies (named on the card).
